timestamp_source: Latest Maven Surefire report modification time, consistent with the test log.
problem: Concurrent replacement of two different empty carts could deadlock during cart_items insertion and return HTTP 500.

change.reason: Avoid range gap locks from empty-cart deletes blocking another shopper's insertion.
change.scope: This cart replacement transaction only; no global isolation, checkout or UI change.

baseline_regression_suite.database_error: MySQLTransactionRollbackException: Deadlock found when trying to get lock

coverage: Force both different-shopper empty-cart deletes to finish before either insert; both requests return HTTP 200 with correct items.
An invalid second SKU rolls back the replacement and preserves the previous cart.
Concurrent replacements for the same shopper leave one complete submitted cart, without mixed items.

aws_status: Demo remains torn down; post-fix AWS and live browser tests pending.

release.reason: The fix passed local API tests; post-fix AWS and live purchase verification remain pending.

limitations: No AWS redeployment or post-fix live browser run was performed.
The November 7 live browser failure remains recorded as observed at that time.
The regression covers the reproduced empty-cart deadlock and transaction integrity; it does not prove every possible database contention pattern.
